title: 第七章沙碛战孤剑破千围第八章秘辛露侠心遇相知
content_zh:
朔风卷着砂砾，如万千碎刃，抽打在萧琰的甲胄上，发出“噼啪”脆响，落得满身尘黄。他背倚着半截残破的烽燧，锈迹斑斑的烽烟柱早已没了往日的挺拔，在狂风中摇摇欲坠，如同他此刻的处境——身陷三万沙盗重围，身边的五十名玄甲卫士，只剩五具冰冷的尸身，横卧在滚烫的沙砾之上，鲜血浸透了黄沙，又被狂风迅速吸干，只留下一片片深褐的印记，在茫茫戈壁中，触目惊心。
萧琰抬手，抹去脸颊上的沙粒与血痕，指腹触到一道深可见骨的伤口，是方才突围时，被沙盗的弯刀所划，血腥味混杂着砂砾的干涩，刺鼻难闻。他腰间的“寒江”剑微微震颤，剑鞘上的云纹早已被风沙磨得模糊，却依旧难掩其内里的凛冽锋芒。这把剑，陪他走过了雁门关的风雪，踏过了江南的烟雨，斩过叛国的逆贼，诛过作恶的盗寇，如今，却要陪着他，在这无人问津的沙碛之中，与数千强敌，决一死战。
“萧琰，降了吧！”沙盗阵中，传来一声粗哑的嘶吼，为首的沙盗头目，骑着一匹通体漆黑的烈马，身披兽皮铠甲，脸上一道刀疤从眉骨延伸到下颌，眼神凶狠如狼，手中握着一柄沉重的狼牙棒，棒尖的铁刺在烈日下泛着寒光，“交出你身上的兵符，本帅饶你全尸，否则，定让你挫骨扬灰，葬身沙腹！”
头目身后，是密密麻麻的沙盗，他们个个衣衫褴褛，面黄肌瘦，却眼神狂热，手中握着弯刀、长矛、狼牙棒，各式各样的兵器，在风沙中泛着冰冷的光泽。他们常年盘踞在这片沙碛之上，烧杀抢掠，无恶不作，过往的商队、戍边的士兵，只要落入他们手中，从未有过生还之地。此次，他们得知萧琰奉命押送粮草前往西疆，兵力薄弱，便倾巢而出，设下埋伏，欲一举夺下粮草与兵符，而后直取西疆重镇。
萧琰缓缓站直身子，玄甲上的沙尘簌簌落下，他没有回应沙盗头目的叫嚣，只是缓缓抽出了腰间的寒江剑。拔剑的瞬间，一道清冷的寒光划破漫天黄沙，剑鸣清越，如寒泉漱石，盖过了狂风的呼啸，也盖过了沙盗的聒噪。剑身狭长，寒光凛冽，映出他苍白却坚毅的脸庞，那双眼睛，如同寒潭深处的星光，虽历经疲惫与伤痛，却依旧锐利如鹰，带着一往无前的决绝，没有丝毫惧色。
“敬酒不吃吃罚酒！”沙盗头目见状，怒不可遏，猛地挥了挥手，嘶吼道，“兄弟们，杀！取萧琰的首级者，赏黄金百两，粮草千石！”
随着头目的一声令下，数千沙盗如同潮水般涌了上来，他们嗷嗷叫着，挥舞着手中的兵器，踏着滚烫的沙砾，朝着萧琰扑去，密密麻麻，层层叠叠，将萧琰围得水泄不通，连一丝缝隙都没有。狂风之中，沙砾纷飞，刀光剑影交织，杀意弥漫，令人窒息。
萧琰神色不变，双脚稳稳扎根在沙砾之上，身形如松，手中的寒江剑微微下垂，剑尖贴着黄沙，蓄势待发。他深谙剑术之道，自幼习得家传剑法，后又得名师指点，将各家剑法融会贯通，练就了一套“寒江十三式”，剑法凌厉，变幻莫测，快如闪电，稳如泰山，既能正面硬刚强敌，也能迂回巧破围困。此刻，面对千军万马的围攻，他没有慌乱，反而静下心来，凝神聚力，将体内残存的内力，缓缓灌注到寒江剑中，剑身的寒光愈发凛冽，剑鸣也愈发清越。
第一个沙盗冲到了萧琰面前，手中的弯刀高高举起，带着呼啸的狂风，朝着萧琰的头颅劈去，刀势凶猛，势大力沉，显然是拼尽了全力。萧琰眼神一凝，不退反进，身形微微一侧，巧妙地避开了这致命一击，同时，手中的寒江剑顺势一撩，剑尖如灵蛇出洞，精准地刺入了那名沙盗的咽喉。
“噗嗤”一声，鲜血喷涌而出，溅在萧琰的甲胄上，也溅在寒江剑上，剑身的寒光被鲜血染红，更添了几分凄厉。那名沙盗瞪大了眼睛，脸上写满了难以置信，身体缓缓倒下，重重地摔在沙砾之上，抽搐了几下，便没了动静，很快，就被风沙覆盖了大半。
一招得手，萧琰没有丝毫停顿，身形如鬼魅般闪动，手中的寒江剑舞动起来，寒光四射，剑影纷飞，“寒江十三式”被他施展得淋漓尽致。他的剑法，快得不可思议，每一剑都精准狠辣，直指要害，没有丝毫多余的动作，如同行云流水般，一气呵成。沙盗们虽人多势众，却根本无法近身，只能眼睁睁地看着身边的同伴，一个个倒在萧琰的剑下，惨叫声、剑鸣声、狂风的呼啸声，交织在一起，响彻了整个沙碛。
一名沙盗挥舞着长矛，从萧琰的身后偷袭而来，长矛带着凌厉的劲风，直指萧琰的后心。萧琰仿佛背后长了眼睛一般，身形微微一旋，手中的寒江剑反手一削，“当”的一声脆响，精准地削在了长矛的杆上，力道之大，直接将长矛削断，同时，剑身顺势一送，剑尖刺入了那名沙盗的后心，那名沙盗惨叫一声，向前扑倒在地，没了气息。
又有三名沙盗同时围攻而来，弯刀、长矛、狼牙棒，三种兵器同时朝着萧琰袭来，封死了他所有的退路。萧琰神色一凛，脚下踏出玄妙的步法，身形如同风中的柳絮，轻盈地躲闪着，避开了三人的围攻，同时，手中的寒江剑快速舞动，剑光如网，将三人笼罩其中。“唰唰唰”三剑，剑光一闪而过，三名沙盗还没来得及反应，咽喉处便都出现了一道细细的伤口，鲜血喷涌而出，三人同时倒下，成为了沙碛中的一抔黄土。
激战片刻，萧琰的身上又添了数道伤口，有刀伤，有矛伤，鲜血顺着伤口流淌而下，浸湿了衣衫，也滴落在黄沙之上，瞬间被吸干。他的呼吸渐渐急促，体内的内力也在快速消耗，手脚也开始变得沉重起来，每挥出一剑，都要耗费极大的力气。但他的眼神，依旧坚毅，手中的寒江剑，依旧没有停下，他知道，自己不能倒下，身后，是西疆数十万戍边士兵的粮草，是家国百姓的安宁，他一旦倒下，粮草被夺，西疆必乱，无数百姓将会遭受战乱之苦，所以，他必须坚持下去，哪怕拼尽最后一丝力气，也要杀出重围。
沙盗头目骑在马上，看着眼前的一幕，脸色越来越阴沉。他原本以为，凭借着数千沙盗的兵力，想要拿下萧琰，不过是轻而易举的事情，却没想到，萧琰的剑法竟然如此凌厉，独自一人，竟然斩杀了他上百名手下，而且依旧屹立不倒，眼神中的决绝，丝毫未减。他心中的怒火，越来越盛，同时，也多了几分忌惮——他从未见过如此勇猛的人，如此凌厉的剑法，在千军万马的围攻之下，竟然还能保持如此强悍的战斗力。
“废物！都是废物！”沙盗头目怒吼一声，猛地拍了一下马背，烈马吃痛，扬起前蹄，发出一声长嘶。他纵身一跃，从马背上跳了下来，手中的狼牙棒紧紧握住，一步步朝着萧琰走去，身上的杀意，越来越浓，“萧琰，本帅亲自来会会你！我倒要看看，你究竟有几斤几两！”
沙盗头目身形高大魁梧，步伐沉重，每走一步，沙砾都会被踩得深陷下去，他手中的狼牙棒，重达数十斤，挥舞起来，势大力沉，威力无穷。他常年在沙碛中厮杀，练就了一身强悍的蛮力，手中的狼牙棒，不知砸死过多少强敌，在这片沙碛之上，几乎无人能挡。
萧琰看着一步步走来的沙盗头目，缓缓调整着呼吸，将体内残存的内力，全部灌注到寒江剑中，剑身的寒光，几乎要将漫天黄沙都染成白色。他知道，这是一场硬仗，沙盗头目实力强悍，远非那些普通的沙盗可比，想要战胜他，绝非易事，甚至可能要付出生命的代价，但他没有退缩，依旧挺直了脊梁，眼神坚定地盯着沙盗头目，做好了迎战的准备。
“受死吧！”沙盗头目走到萧琰面前，猛地大喝一声，手中的狼牙棒高高举起，带着雷霆万钧之势，朝着萧琰的头颅砸去，狼牙棒划破空气，发出“呼呼”的劲风，砂砾被气流卷起，四处飞溅，威力惊人。这一击，凝聚了他全身的蛮力，若是被击中，必定粉身碎骨，尸骨无存。
萧琰眼神一凝，不敢有丝毫大意，双脚稳稳扎根在沙砾之上，手中的寒江剑猛地向上一扬，“当”的一声脆响，剑尖精准地撞上了狼牙棒的棒尖，巨大的冲击力，让萧琰的手臂剧烈地颤抖起来，虎口被震得开裂，鲜血顺着剑柄流淌而下，滴落在黄沙之上。他的身形，也被这股冲击力震得连连后退了几步，脚下的沙砾，被踩得簌簌作响。

沙盗头目见状，眼中闪过一丝得意，猛地加大了力道，狼牙棒再次下压，想要将萧琰的剑压断，而后一举击杀萧琰。萧琰咬紧牙关，脸色苍白如纸，体内的内力源源不断地灌注到寒江剑中，死死地支撑着，不让狼牙棒再下压分毫。他的手臂，已经开始发麻，浑身的肌肉，都在剧烈地抽搐，但他依旧没有放弃，眼神中的决绝，愈发浓烈。
僵持片刻，萧琰知道，这样下去，自己迟早会被耗死，必须想出对策，打破僵局。他猛地脚下一踏，身形微微一侧，巧妙地避开了狼牙棒的力道，同时，手中的寒江剑顺势一滑，沿着狼牙棒的棒身，快速下滑，剑尖直指沙盗头目的手腕。这一剑，快如闪电，精准狠辣，直指要害，不给沙盗头目任何反应的机会。
沙盗头目大惊失色，没想到萧琰竟然会突然变招，他来不及多想，连忙松开手，想要避开这致命一击。但萧琰的剑，实在太快了，“唰”的一声，剑尖已经划破了他的手腕，鲜血喷涌而出，滴落在黄沙之上。沙盗头目吃痛，闷哼一声，手中的狼牙棒“哐当”一声掉落在沙砾之上，发出沉闷的声响。
萧琰没有丝毫停顿，趁胜追击，身形如鬼魅般冲到沙盗头目面前，手中的寒江剑，再次刺出，剑尖直指沙盗头目的咽喉。沙盗头目手腕受伤，无力反抗，只能眼睁睁地看着寒江剑，一点点靠近自己的咽喉，他脸上的得意与凶狠，瞬间被恐惧所取代，眼中写满了难以置信，他怎么也想不到，自己竟然会败在萧琰的手中，败在这一柄孤剑之下。
“噗嗤”一声，寒江剑精准地刺入了沙盗头目的咽喉，剑尖从他的后颈穿出，鲜血喷涌而出，溅满了萧琰的脸庞。沙盗头目瞪大了眼睛，嘴巴张了张，想要说什么，却发不出任何声音，他的身体，缓缓地倒了下去，重重地摔在沙砾之上，再也没有了动静。
沙盗们看到头目被杀，瞬间陷入了混乱之中，他们个个惊慌失措，眼神中充满了恐惧，再也没有了之前的狂热与嚣张。他们常年跟随头目，在这片沙碛之上厮杀，头目，就是他们的主心骨，如今，主心骨被杀，他们群龙无首，人心惶惶，再也没有了战斗力，一个个都停下了手中的动作，站在原地，不知所措，甚至有人，已经开始悄悄后退，想要逃离这片是非之地。
萧琰缓缓拔出寒江剑，剑尖的鲜血，顺着剑身滴落，落在黄沙之上，发出“嗒嗒”的声响。他站直身子，浑身是伤，衣衫染血，脸色苍白如纸，呼吸急促，手脚沉重，体内的内力，已经消耗殆尽，连挥剑的力气，都快要没有了。但他的身形，依旧挺拔如松，眼神依旧锐利如鹰，手中的寒江剑，依旧泛着清冷的寒光，带着一股威慑人心的气势，屹立在漫天黄沙之中，如同一位不败的战神。
他缓缓抬起手中的寒江剑，指向眼前的沙盗，声音沙哑，却带着一股不容置疑的威严，响彻在整个沙碛之上：“头目已死，尔等若再顽抗，定当格杀勿论！若肯放下兵器，束手就擒，本将可饶尔等不死！”
沙盗们听到萧琰的话，更加惊慌失措，他们看着萧琰手中的寒江剑，看着地上头目的尸体，又看了看身边密密麻麻的同伴，心中的恐惧，越来越浓。他们知道，萧琰的剑法凌厉，连头目都不是他的对手，他们这些人，若是继续顽抗，也只是白白送死，根本没有任何胜算。
片刻之后，一名沙盗率先放下了手中的弯刀，“噗通”一声跪倒在沙砾之上，颤抖着说道：“我投降！我投降！求将军饶我不死！”
有了第一个，就有第二个，越来越多的沙盗，纷纷放下手中的兵器，跪倒在沙砾之上，不停地磕头求饶，声音此起彼伏，充满了恐惧与卑微。他们之中，有一些人，依旧心存侥幸，想要趁机逃离，却被萧琰眼神中的威慑力吓得不敢动弹，只能乖乖地跪倒在地，束手就擒。
萧琰看着眼前跪倒在地的数千沙盗，没有丝毫怜悯，这些沙盗，烧杀抢掠，无恶不作，手上沾满了无辜百姓与戍边士兵的鲜血，本就该死。但他也知道，自己此刻内力耗尽，身受重伤，根本无法将这数千沙盗全部斩杀，而且，若是将他们全部斩杀，也不利于后续的安抚与治理。于是，他缓缓开口，声音沙哑却坚定：“本将言出必行，饶尔等不死，但从今往后，尔等必须放下屠刀，不得再为非作歹，若敢再犯，定当挫骨扬灰，绝不姑息！”
“谢将军饶命！谢将军饶命！”沙盗们纷纷磕头谢恩，脸上写满了感激与恐惧，不停地发誓，从今往后，再也不敢为非作歹，一定会洗心革面，重新做人。
萧琰摆了摆手，示意他们起身，而后，他缓缓收起寒江剑，剑鸣清越，渐渐平息。他转过身，看向身后残破的烽燧，看向身边卫士的尸身，眼中闪过一丝悲凉与痛惜。这些卫士，跟随他出生入死，忠心耿耿，如今，却都葬身于此，再也无法回到家乡，无法与家人团聚。他心中暗暗发誓，一定会好好安葬这些卫士，一定会守住西疆的安宁，不让他们的鲜血白流。
狂风依旧在呼啸，砂砾依旧在纷飞，漫天黄沙之中，萧琰独自一人，手持寒江剑，屹立在残破的烽燧之下，身后，是数千束手就擒的沙盗，身前，是茫茫无际的沙碛，以及远方西疆的方向。他浑身是伤，疲惫不堪，却依旧挺拔如松，眼神坚定，手中的孤剑，虽历经厮杀，却依旧凛冽锋芒。
沙碛一战，孤剑破千围。萧琰以一己之力，凭借着凌厉的剑法与一往无前的决绝，在数千沙盗的围攻之下，斩杀头目，击溃敌军，成功杀出重围，守住了粮草与兵符，也守住了西疆的希望。这场战斗，注定会被载入史册，成为一段传奇，而萧琰，也注定会成为这片沙碛之上，最耀眼的战神，他的名字，将会被无数人铭记，他的勇气与忠诚，将会被永远传颂。
夕阳西下，金色的余晖，洒在萧琰的身上，将他的身影拉得很长很长，映在茫茫黄沙之中，与残破的烽燧、跪倒的沙盗、冰冷的尸身，构成了一幅悲壮而豪迈的画卷。萧琰缓缓抬起头，望向远方，眼中充满了坚定与期盼，他知道，这场战斗，虽然胜利了，但他的使命，还没有完成，前路依旧充满了坎坷与危险，但他不会退缩，会一直带着手中的寒江剑，带着卫士们的期望，勇往直前，守护好这片土地，守护好家国百姓的安宁。
寒风吹过，卷起萧琰的衣衫，也卷起地上的沙砾，寒江剑在剑鞘中微微震颤，仿佛在诉说着这场战斗的惨烈，也仿佛在预示着，前路的征程，依旧任重而道远。但萧琰无所畏惧，他的心中，有信仰，有忠诚，有勇气，手中，有孤剑，有力量，哪怕前路再难，哪怕再遇千军万马的围困，他也会依旧挺身而出，以孤剑破千围，以忠诚赴使命，不负家国，不负初心。

The wind rolled up the gravel, like thousands of broken blades, and struck Xiao Yan's armor, making a crackling sound and covering his body with yellow dust. He was leaning on a half-broken beacon. The rusty beacon smoke column had long lost its former height and was crumbling in the strong wind, just like his current situation - surrounded by 30,000 sand bandits, surrounded by fifty Xuanmen. There were only five cold corpses of Guard A left, lying on the hot gravel. The blood was soaked in the yellow sand, and was quickly sucked dry by the strong wind, leaving only patches of dark brown marks, which were shocking in the vast Gobi desert.
Xiao Yan raised his hand and wiped away the sand and blood on his cheek. His fingertips touched a deep wound with bone visible. It was scratched by the sand bandit's scimitar when he broke out of the encirclement. The smell of blood was mixed with the dryness of the gravel, making it pungent and unpleasant. The "Hanjiang" sword at his waist trembled slightly, and the cloud pattern on the scabbard had long been blurred by the wind and sand, but it still couldn't hide the cold edge inside. This sword has accompanied him through the wind and snow of Yanmen Pass, stepped through the mist and rain in the south of the Yangtze River, killed the treasonous traitors, and punished the evil bandits. Now, it will accompany him to fight to the death with thousands of powerful enemies in this deserted moraine.
"Xiao Yan, surrender!" A hoarse roar came from the sand bandit formation. The leader of the sand bandits was riding a dark horse and wearing animal skin armor. A scar on his face extended from his brow bone to his chin, and his eyes The god was as fierce as a wolf, holding a heavy mace in his hand. The iron spikes on the tip of the stick shone coldly under the scorching sun. "Hand over the military talisman on your body, and I will spare your whole body. Otherwise, you will be buried in the sand with your bones broken and ashes scattered!"
Behind the leader, there were densely packed sand bandits. They were all in ragged clothes, with sallow faces and thin muscles, but with fanatical eyes. They held scimitars, spears, maces, and various weapons in their hands, which glowed with an icy sheen in the wind and sand. They have been entrenched on this sandy moraine all year round, burning, killing, looting, and committing all kinds of evil. Passing caravans and soldiers guarding the border will never survive as long as they fall into their hands. This time, they learned that Xiao Yan had been ordered to escort grain and grass to Western Xinjiang, and their troops were weak, so they went out in full force and set up an ambush, hoping to seize the grain, grass and military symbols in one fell swoop, and then directly take the important town in Western Xinjiang.
Xiao Yan slowly stood up straight, and the sand dust on his black armor fell rustlingly. He did not respond to the shouts of the sand bandit leader, but slowly drew out the Hanjiang Sword from his waist. The moment he drew his sword, a cold light cut through the yellow sand in the sky. The sound of the sword was clear and clear, like a cold spring washing stones, covering up the roar of the wind and the noise of the sand bandits. The sword was long and narrow, and the cold light reflected his pale but resolute face. His eyes were like the stars in the depths of the cold pool. Although they had experienced fatigue and pain, they were still as sharp as an eagle, with determination to move forward without any fear.
"If you don't eat the toast, you will be fined!" Upon seeing this, the leader of the Sand Bandits was furious. He waved his hands violently and shouted, "Brothers, kill! Whoever takes Xiao Yan's head will be rewarded with a hundred taels of gold and a thousand stones of food and grass!"
Following the leader's order, thousands of sand thieves surged up like a tide. They howled, waved their weapons, stepped on the hot gravel, and rushed toward Xiao Yan. They were densely packed and layered, and they surrounded Xiao Yan tightly without even a single gap. In the strong wind, sand and gravel were flying, swords and swords were intertwined, murderous intent was permeated, and it was suffocating.
Xiao Yan's expression remained unchanged, his feet firmly rooted on the gravel, his body like a pine tree, the Hanjiang Sword in his hand drooped slightly, the tip of the sword was pressed against the yellow sand, ready to go. He is well versed in the art of swordsmanship. He learned the swordsmanship passed down from his family since he was a child. Later, under the guidance of a famous master, he integrated various swordsmanships and mastered a set of "Hanjiang Thirteen Styles". His swordsmanship is fierce and unpredictable, as fast as lightning and as steady as Mount Tai. He can not only confront powerful enemies head-on, but also use circuitous ways to break through sieges. At this moment, facing the siege of thousands of troops, he did not panic. Instead, he calmed down, concentrated his energy, and slowly poured the remaining inner strength in his body into the Hanjiang Sword. The cold light of the sword became more and more severe.Chill, the sound of the sword became clearer and clearer.
The first sand bandit rushed in front of Xiao Yan, raised the scimitar in his hand high, and slashed towards Xiao Yan's head with the roaring wind. The sword was fierce and heavy, and he obviously used all his strength. Xiao Yan's eyes narrowed and he advanced instead of retreating. He tilted his body slightly to one side and skillfully avoided the fatal blow. At the same time, he raised the Hanjiang Sword in his hand, and the tip of the sword came out of its hole like a snake, accurately piercing the throat of the sand bandit.
With a "puff", blood spurted out, splashing on Xiao Yan's armor and the Hanjiang sword. The cold light of the sword was dyed red by the blood, making it even more tragic. The sand pirate's eyes widened and his face was filled with disbelief. His body slowly fell down and fell heavily on the gravel. He twitched a few times and then stopped moving. Soon, most of it was covered by the wind and sand.
After a successful move, Xiao Yan did not pause at all, his body flashed like a ghost, the Hanjiang sword in his hand danced, cold light shot out, sword shadows flew, and he performed the "Thirteen Hanjiang Styles" to the fullest. His swordsmanship was incredibly fast, and each sword strike was precise and brutal, hitting the vital point without any unnecessary movements. It was done in one go, like clouds and flowing water. Although the sand bandits were outnumbered, they were unable to get close at all. They could only watch helplessly as their companions fell to Xiao Yan's sword one by one. The screams, the sound of swords, and the howling of the wind were intertwined and resounded throughout the sand moraine.
A sand bandit brandished a spear and sneaked up from behind Xiao Yan. The spear, carrying a strong wind, was pointed directly at Xiao Yan's back. As if there were eyes on his back, Xiao Yan spun slightly and slashed the Hanjiang Sword in his hand with his backhand. With a sharp "dang" sound, he accurately cut the spear shaft. The force was so strong that it directly broke the spear. At the same time, the sword blade was sent forward and the tip of the sword pierced the back of the sand bandit. The sand bandit screamed and fell forward to the ground, lifeless.
Three more sand bandits attacked at the same time. Scimitars, spears, and maces all attacked Xiao Yan at the same time, blocking all his escape routes. Xiao Yan's expression was stern, and he made mysterious footwork. His body was like catkins in the wind, dodging lightly and avoiding the attack of the three people. At the same time, the Hanjiang Sword in his hand danced rapidly, and the sword light was like a net, covering the three people. "Swish, swish, swish", the sword light flashed past. Before the three sand thieves could react, a thin wound appeared in their throats. Blood spurted out. The three fell down at the same time, becoming a handful of loess in the sand moraine.
After a moment of fierce fighting, Xiao Yan received several more wounds on his body, including knife wounds and spear wounds. Blood flowed down the wounds, soaked his clothes, and dripped on the yellow sand, where it was sucked dry instantly. His breathing gradually became faster, the internal energy in his body was rapidly depleted, and his hands and feet began to become heavy. Every time he swung the sword, it took a lot of effort. But his eyes were still resolute, and the Hanjiang Sword in his hand still did not stop. He knew that he could not fall. Behind him was the food and grass of hundreds of thousands of soldiers guarding the border in Western Xinjiang, and the peace of the people of his home and country. Once he fell, the food and grass were taken away, Western Xinjiang would be in chaos, and countless people would suffer from the war. Therefore, he must persist, even if he uses his last ounce of strength, he must fight his way out of the siege.
The leader of the Sand Bandits was riding on his horse, looking at the scene in front of him, his face becoming increasingly gloomy. He originally thought that with the strength of thousands of Sand Bandits, it would be a piece of cake to capture Xiao Yan, but he never expected that Xiao Yan's swordsmanship was so powerful. He could kill hundreds of his men alone, and he still stood tall, with the determination in his eyes undiminished at all. The anger in his heart was getting stronger and stronger, and at the same time, he was also a little more fearful - he had never seen such a brave person, such a fierce swordsman, who could maintain such a strong combat effectiveness under the siege of thousands of troops.
"Trash! They're all trash!" the leader of the sand bandits roared angrily.With a loud sound, he slapped the horse's back suddenly. The strong horse felt the pain, raised its front hooves, and let out a long neigh. He jumped down from the horse, holding the mace tightly in his hand, and walked towards Xiao Yan step by step, with the murderous intention in his body getting stronger and stronger, "Xiao Yan, I am here to meet you in person! I want to see how much you weigh!"
The leader of the Sand Bandits was tall and burly, and his steps were heavy. Every step he took would cause the gravel to sink deeply. The mace in his hand weighed dozens of kilograms. When he swung it, it was powerful and powerful. He has been fighting in the sand moraine for many years, and has developed a strong brute force. With the mace in his hand, he has killed countless powerful enemies. On this sand moraine, almost no one can stop him.
Xiao Yan looked at the leader of the sand pirates walking towards him, slowly adjusted his breathing, and poured all the remaining internal energy in his body into the Hanjiang Sword. The cold light from the sword almost dyed the yellow sand in the sky white. He knew that this was a tough battle. The leader of the sand pirates was far more powerful than ordinary sand pirates. It would not be easy to defeat him, and it might even cost his life. However, he did not flinch. He still straightened his spine and stared at the leader of the sand pirates firmly, ready to fight.
"Suffer death!" The leader of the Sand Bandits walked up to Xiao Yan and shouted loudly. He raised the mace in his hand high and hit Xiao Yan's head with a thunderous force. The mace cut through the air and sent out a "whooshing" wind. The gravel was picked up by the airflow and splashed everywhere with astonishing power. This blow gathered all the brute strength of his body. If he were hit, his body would be shattered into pieces and no bones would be left.
Xiao Yan's eyes were focused, and he did not dare to be careless. His feet were firmly rooted on the gravel, and the Hanjiang Sword in his hand was raised sharply. With a crisp "ding" sound, the tip of the sword accurately hit the tip of the mace. The huge impact made Xiao Yan's arms tremble violently. The tiger's mouth was cracked by the shock, and blood flowed down the hilt and dripped on the yellow sand. His figure was also shaken by the impact and took several steps back. The gravel under his feet made a rustling sound.
Upon seeing this, the leader of the Sand Bandits flashed a trace of pride in his eyes, and suddenly increased his strength. He pressed down on the mace again, trying to break Xiao Yan's sword, and then killed Xiao Yan in one fell swoop. Xiao Yan clenched his teeth, his face was as pale as paper, and the internal force in his body was continuously poured into Hanjiang Sword, holding on tightly to prevent the mace from pressing down any further. His arms had begun to feel numb, and the muscles all over his body were twitching violently, but he still did not give up, and the determination in his eyes became stronger and stronger.
After a moment of stalemate, Xiao Yan knew that if this continued, he would be exhausted sooner or later, and he had to come up with a countermeasure to break the deadlock. He suddenly stepped on his foot and tilted his body slightly to avoid the force of the mace. At the same time, the Hanjiang Sword in his hand slid down quickly along the body of the mace, and the sword tip pointed directly at the wrist of the sand bandit leader. This sword was as fast as lightning, precise and ruthless, pointing directly at the vital point, without giving the sand bandit leader any chance to react.
The leader of the Sand Bandits was shocked. He didn't expect Xiao Yan to suddenly change his tactics. He didn't have time to think too much and quickly let go of his hand, trying to avoid this fatal blow. But Xiao Yan's sword was too fast. With a "swish" sound, the tip of the sword had already cut his wrist, and blood spurted out and dripped on the yellow sand. The leader of the Sand Bandits grunted in pain, and the mace in his hand fell to the gravel with a clang, making a dull sound.
Xiao Yan didn't pause at all, taking advantage of the victory to pursue, and rushed to the leader of the sand bandits like a ghost. The Hanjiang sword in his hand thrust out again, with the tip of the sword pointing directly at the throat of the leader of the sand bandits. The leader of the Sand Pirates was injured on the wrist and was unable to resist. He could only watch the Hanjiang Sword getting closer to his throat. The pride and ferocity on his face were instantly replaced by fear. His eyes were filled with disbelief. He never imagined that he would be defeated.In Xiao Yan's hands, he was defeated by this lone sword.
With a "Pfft" sound, the Hanjiang Sword accurately penetrated the throat of the Sand Bandit leader. The tip of the sword passed through the back of his neck, and blood spurted out, splattering all over Xiao Yan's face. The leader of the Sand Bandits widened his eyes and opened his mouth. He wanted to say something, but no sound came out. His body slowly fell down and fell heavily on the gravel, and there was no more movement.
When the sand bandits saw their leader being killed, they fell into chaos instantly. They all panicked, their eyes were full of fear, and they no longer had the enthusiasm and arrogance they had before. They have followed the leader all year round and fought on this sand moraine. The leader was their backbone. Now, the backbone was killed. They were leaderless and panicked. They no longer had fighting power. They all stopped what they were doing and stood there, at a loss. Some even started to retreat quietly, trying to escape from this land of right and wrong.
Xiao Yan slowly pulled out the Hanjiang Sword. The blood from the tip of the sword dripped down the sword body and fell on the yellow sand, making a "ta-ta-ta" sound. He stood up straight, his body was covered with injuries, his clothes were stained with blood, his face was as pale as paper, his breathing was rapid, his hands and feet were heavy, the internal energy in his body had been exhausted, and he almost had no strength to swing his sword. But his figure was still as tall and straight as a pine, his eyes were still as sharp as an eagle, and the Hanjiang Sword in his hand still glowed with a cold light, carrying an intimidating aura, standing in the yellow sand of the sky, like an undefeated god of war.
He slowly raised the Hanjiang Sword in his hand and pointed it at the sand bandits in front of him. His voice was hoarse, but it carried an unquestionable majesty that resounded throughout the entire sand moraine: "The leader is dead. If you continue to resist, I will kill you without mercy! If you are willing to put down your weapons and capture without restraint, I will spare your life!"
When the Sand Bandits heard Xiao Yan's words, they became even more panicked. They looked at the Hanjiang Sword in Xiao Yan's hand, at the corpse of the leader on the ground, and at the dense crowd of companions around them. The fear in their hearts became more and more intense. They knew that Xiao Yan's swordsmanship was so fierce that even the leader was no match for him. If they continued to resist, they would die in vain without any chance of winning.
After a while, one of the sand bandits was the first to put down the scimitar in his hand, and with a "pop" he knelt down on the gravel and said tremblingly: "I surrender! I surrender! Please spare my life, General!"
With the first one, there was the second one. More and more sand bandits put down their weapons one after another, knelt down on the gravel, and kept kowtowing to beg for mercy. Their voices came and went, full of fear and humility. Some of them were still lucky and wanted to take the opportunity to escape, but they were so frightened by the intimidation in Xiao Yan's eyes that they did not dare to move. They could only kneel down obediently and surrender.
Xiao Yan looked at the thousands of sand bandits kneeling on the ground in front of him without any mercy. These sand bandits burned, killed, looted, and committed all kinds of evil. Their hands were stained with the blood of innocent people and border soldiers, and they deserved to die. But he also knew that at this moment, his internal strength was exhausted and he was seriously injured. He could not kill all the thousands of sand bandits. Moreover, if he killed them all, it would not be conducive to subsequent comfort and management. So, he spoke slowly, with a hoarse but firm voice: "I will do what I say, and I will spare your life, but from now on, you must put down the butcher's knife, and you must not do evil again. If you dare to do it again, you will be shattered and ashes will be spread, and we will never tolerate it!"
"Thank you, General, for your life! Thank you, General, for your life!" The sand bandits kowtowed one after another, their faces full of gratitude and fear, and they kept swearing that from now on, they would never dare to do evil again, and they would definitely change their minds and start a new life.
Xiao Yan waved his hand to signal them to stand up. Then, he slowly put away the Hanjiang Sword, and the sound of the sword gradually subsided. He turned around and looked at the broken beacon behind him and the bodies of the guards beside him, with a trace of sadness and regret flashing in his eyes. These guards, follow himThey were loyal and loyal through life and death, but now they are all buried here. They can never return to their hometown or reunite with their families. He secretly swore in his heart that he would bury these guards properly and guard the peace of Western Xinjiang to prevent their blood from being shed in vain.
The strong wind is still howling, the gravel is still flying, and in the sky full of yellow sand, Xiao Yan is alone, holding the Hanjiang Sword, standing under the broken beacon. Behind him are thousands of helpless sand thieves. In front of him is the boundless sand moraine, and the direction of the distant western border. He was covered in injuries and exhausted, but he was still as tall as a pine tree, his eyes were firm, and the lone sword in his hand was still as sharp as ever despite the battle.
In the battle of Shaqi, a single sword broke through thousands of enemies. Xiao Yan single-handedly relied on his fierce swordsmanship and indomitable determination to kill the leader and defeat the enemy army under the siege of thousands of sand bandits. He successfully broke out of the siege, saved the food, grass, military symbols, and the hope of Western Xinjiang. This battle is destined to be recorded in history and become a legend, and Xiao Yan is also destined to become the most dazzling God of War on this desert moraine. His name will be remembered by countless people, and his courage and loyalty will be praised forever.
As the sun sets, the golden afterglow shines on Xiao Yan's body, stretching his figure very long, reflected in the vast yellow sand, and together with the broken beacon, the kneeling sand bandit, and the cold corpse, form a tragic and heroic picture. Xiao Yan slowly raised his head and looked into the distance, his eyes full of determination and expectation. He knew that although he had won this battle, his mission had not yet been completed. The road ahead was still full of ups and downs and dangers, but he would not back down. He would always carry the Hanjiang Sword in his hand and the expectations of the guards, and move forward bravely to protect this land and the peace of the people of his home and country.
The cold wind blew by, rolling up Xiao Yan's clothes and the gravel on the ground. The Hanjiang Sword trembled slightly in its scabbard, as if telling the tragedy of this battle, and also seemed to indicate that the journey ahead was still long and arduous. But Xiao Yan is fearless. He has faith, loyalty, and courage in his heart. He has a lone sword and strength in his hand. No matter how difficult the road ahead is, even if he is surrounded by thousands of troops, he will still stand up and break through thousands of sieges with his lone sword. He will go on his mission with loyalty and live up to his family and country and his original intention.
